description: This PHP file contains unit tests for the EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageLeaveReportAPI class, specifically testing the API endpoints related to leave reports within the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It sets up test cases, mocks services, and verifies API behaviors such as retrieval and handling of leave entitlement reports.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageLeaveReportAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageLeaveReportAPI endpoints in the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It includes setup for test data, mock service registration, and various tests for API methods like getAll, delete, update, and validation rules.

methods.description: Tests API behavior when the leave period is not defined in the system configuration.
